newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Office says will meet Q4 expectations.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Office says will meet Q4 expectations.

text.p: U.S. Office Products Co said on Thursday it expects to meet analysts' expectations for the current fourth quarter of net income of $0.30 per share.
"That would seem quite achievable," the company's chairman, Jonathan Ledecky, said in a telephone interview.

U.S. Office Products earlier reported third-quarter ended Jan 25 net income fell to $0.20 per share, compared to $0.33 for the same quarter the year before. Excluding non-recurring charges, the company's net income was $0.30 per share for the third quarter of 1997, compared to $0.16 for the same period in 1996.
